definitions.explanation: To become wider or cover more area.

examples.japanese: {平野|へいや}が{広|ひろ}がっている。

notes:
{広|ひろ}がる is an intransitive verb meaning to spread, extend, or expand.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {広|ひろ}げる (transitive, to spread something)

ASPECT (ている):
{広|ひろ}がっている describes a state of being spread out or extended: {平野|へいや}が{広|ひろ}がっている (the plain extends/stretches out).

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- {噂|うわさ}が{広|ひろ}がる: rumors spread
- {火|ひ}が{広|ひろ}がる: fire spreads
- {被害|ひがい}が{広|ひろ}がる: damage spreads
- {景色|けしき}が{広|ひろ}がる: scenery stretches out
- {可能性|かのうせい}が{広|ひろ}がる: possibilities expand

PATTERNS:
- 〜に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread to ~
- 〜まで{広|ひろ}がる: to spread as far as ~
